visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) View of the floating restaurant named '元祖 海賊料理' (Ganso Kaizoku Ryori) in Kaiyo, Tokushima. The structure is a simple wooden house with a red roof, accessible by a long wooden gangplank. The surrounding water is a vivid, transparent green under a clear blue sky with lush green hills in the distance. (2) Close-up on the restaurant's wooden signboard which features a carved skull and crossbones motif next to the name. The sky is bright, casting a natural daylight glow on the weathered wood. (3) Underwater shots showing the extreme clarity of the sea. Small schools of fish swim near the floating structure, and a wild pufferfish is seen bobbing near a submerged net cage. (4) A man in black and a woman in an apron work on a wooden platform on the water. They hoist a large wicker basket out of the sea, revealing several live Japanese spiny lobsters crawling inside. The background shows a pink and white fishing boat docked nearby. (5) Transition to the restaurant interior, which has a nostalgic Showa-era feel. It features tatami mat floors, low wooden tables, and large windows overlooking the harbor. Portable gas grills are set on the tables ready for cooking. (6) A smiling woman in a green sweater serves a platter of raw seafood including lobsters and scallops. She uses tongs to place the live seafood onto the hot grill. Close-up shots show the scallops opening and lobster pieces twitching on the heat. (7) A variety of sashimi is shown on a plate, including sliced abalone and shells. The woman is then seen eating a piece of cooked seafood with chopsticks, looking delighted. A man in a black shirt is shown eating rice and drinking soup. (8) Close-up of a bowl of miso soup containing a large lobster head and claw. The rich red soup and the steam indicate it is freshly served. (9) The scene moves to the office area where an older man (the owner) shows a secret trapdoor in the wooden floor. Opening the planks reveals the sea directly underneath with more storage baskets for seafood, emphasizing the ocean as a refrigerator concept.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female Mandarin narration introduces the unique floating restaurant. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop track with bright guitar strumming and a light drum beat (approx. 120 BPM). Ambient sounds of gentle water lapping against the structure are faintly audible. (2) A distinct splashing sound occurs as the narrator mentions the fresh ingredients being pulled from the sea. The BGM continues at a steady volume, and the narrator's tone remains excited and friendly with frequent rising intonations. (3) Transition to the sound of sizzling seafood on a metal grill. This sharp, high-frequency sound dominates the mix momentarily. The music maintains its cheerful rhythm. The narrator's pitch is medium-high, reflecting high arousal and positive valence. (4) Ambient indoor room tone is present as the dining experience is described. There are soft sounds of chopsticks clinking against ceramic bowls and the muffled chatter of other guests. The narrator speaks clearly with professional broadcast-level articulation. (5) A metallic creaking and wood thudding sound is heard as the owner opens the floorboards in the office. The acoustic environment shifts to include a more resonant outdoor water sound from below. The narrator's voice drops slightly in volume as she describes the 'secret' storage area. (6) The BGM swells for a final energetic summary. The narrator invites viewers to comment for the address, ending with a high-pitched, enthusiastic closing phrase. The track ends with a clean fade-out.
